Double duty Hyphen is versatile, assembling meals below with robotics while allowing more orders to be prepared manually up top. Makelight UI High-density LEDs illuminate to provide real-time operator guidance. Creating a highly intuitive and hands-free user experience. Crumb trays Catch overflow and food debris for expedited end of day cleaning. The tray slides out for simple removal and is dishwasher safe. Sliding storage Easily load in and store a variety of to-go containers, bowls, or trays used for daily service. Intelligent assembly Ingredient dispensers dynamically adapt to material properties. Ensuring every meal’s precisely portioned and perfectly plated regardless of the ingredient. Standard pan sizes Food pans are sized to the industry standard for ease of operations and ingredient storage. Speed More Capacity Increase speed, increase efficiency, increase throughput.
